name: retcalc-marketing
description: Builds the RetCalc marketing package, one-pager and deck. See ../README.md.

scripts.setup: npm ci && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt
scripts.capture: node shoot2.mjs && node recap.mjs && node guide.mjs && node rp.mjs && node plan.mjs && node story.mjs && node signin.mjs && node logo.mjs
scripts.pdf: node ../build/build.mjs && node render.mjs ../build/package.html ../RetCalc-Marketing-Package.pdf ../.preview/pdf && node render.mjs ../build/onepager.html ../RetCalc-One-Pager.pdf ../.preview/onepager && .venv/bin/python outline.py ../RetCalc-Marketing-Package.pdf ../build/outline.json
